card vi-detail  [decided]
Every card carries its own proof
why: Verbatim quotes, the finding with its numbers, the deps, and the rejected options — all on the card’s own page.

say — verbatim excerpts from this conversation, attributed, so “how did we arrive here” is answerable without re-reading anything.
ev — a pointer to a source node, whose finding carries the numbers.
alt — the options that were rejected, kept, never deleted.

Three versions failed before this one. V1 had titles only. V2 hid the proof in a side panel that leaf cards never opened. V3 copied source text into every card.

  -> depends_on      vi-edges  Four link types: refines, depends_on, supported_by, alternative_to
       why: The proof on each card shows deps and rejected options, which are the depends_on and alternative_to edges this card defines.
  -> supported_by    vi-detail:ex0  
  -> supported_by    vi-detail:ex1  
  -> refines         map-card  A card is a decision with a reason. Options, sources, and excerpts are nodes beside it
  <- depends_on      vi-onview  One view = one card, detail on top, sub-cards below
  <- depends_on      vi-extract  The quotes should be extracted, not written by me

werk — a visual layer over Claude Code.

The log is /Users/eryk.napierala/conductor/workspaces/werk/iqaluit/.werk/log.jsonl. Every command appends one event. Nothing is deleted.

  werk serve [--port 4000]            open the map in a browser, live
                                      "npm run dev" hot-reloads a change under src/ without
                                      restarting (see #werk-hmr), and reloads the page on a
                                      change under web/
       [--allow "Read,Edit,Bash"]     tools the chat pane's agent may use
       [--new]                        forget the stored conversation and start a fresh one.
                                      Without it, serve resumes where it left off.
  werk add <id> --title "..."         propose a card. It does NOT enter the map: it shows as a
                                      ghost until Eryk accepts it — see #werk-propose-new
       [--kind card|source|option] [--why "..."] [--body "..."]
       [--status open|proto] [--who you|me|prototype]
       [--no-basis]                   on record: this card needs no depends_on (a root, a source)
       [--unchallenged]               on record: who:you, decided with no option weighed against it
       [--parent <id>]                also adds a refines edge to <id>
       [--url ...] [--finding ...]    for --kind source
       [--obligation <id>]            this card answers a build's card obligation
                                      (#st-build-card)
                                      cannot set --status decided directly — see "werk status"
                                      a ghost is frozen: no edit, no retitle, no re-add.
                                      To change one, discard it and propose it again.
  werk link <from> <to> --type <t>    t = refines|depends_on|supported_by|alternative_to
       [--why "..."]                  required for depends_on: what <from> takes from <to>.
                                      Linking an existing depends_on again sets its reason.
                                      See #vi-prop-linkwhy
  werk unlink <from> <to> --type <t>
  werk status <id> <status>           decided | open | proto
